name: codegraphagent
description: Code knowledge graph for a project's source: explore, symbol lookup, search and callers, answered from a pre-built index. Runs the upstream CodeGraph 1.6.4 engine (MIT), which indexes about 30 languages including Python, R, TypeScript, JavaScript, C and C++, Rust, Go and Java. The first tool call downloads the engine (about 60 MB, once, checked against a pinned SHA-256). Index a project only when the user asks (codegraphagent_index_project, pass project_dir); the index lives in <project>/.codegraph-biorouter/. Telemetry and update checks are off.

env_vars.description: Set to 1 to disable the engine's file watcher (slow filesystems like WSL2 /mnt drives). Indexed projects then refresh only when re-indexed.
Comma-separated engine tools to offer (upstream names without the codegraph_ prefix). Default: explore,node,search,callers. Others: callees, impact, files, status.
Path to an already-extracted upstream CodeGraph 1.6.4 bundle (the folder holding codegraph-<platform>/). Skips the first-use download, for air-gapped machines and CI.
